name: Spotify_Wheel
author: Adam-loy
description: Spotify in the Omarchy bar: always present, with background playback, transport, search, and a panel over the current album cover.

barWidget.description: Real-time playing from Spotify, with search, seek, transport, shuffle, repeat and volume over the current album cover.

schema.label: Maximum label width (px)
schema.description: Track text wider than this scrolls instead of stretching the bar.

schema.label: Show artist next to the title
Show a progress underline in the bar
Hide the widget when Spotify is not running
schema.description: Off by default, so a dimmed Spotify icon is always in the bar: it searches and it launches the app. Turn this on to hide the slot whenever Spotify is not running.

schema.label: Search shows
schema.description: Whether the search tab lists songs or albums.

schema.label: New releases starts on
schema.description: Genre or mood the new releases tab asks for when it opens. Apple's search sorts by release date, so a narrow genre is what keeps genuinely new records near the top.

schema.label: Left click
schema.description: Which action left click takes. The other of the two lands on right click.

schema.label: Accent color
schema.description: Color of the icon, progress underline, and popup controls. "Album art" takes the dominant color of the current cover.

schema.label: Album cover behind the panel
schema.description: Blurs the current cover into the panel background, tinted and dimmed to whatever keeps the theme's text readable. Needs ImageMagick and curl for the color reading; without them the panel keeps its plain background.

schema.label: How much cover shows through (%)
schema.description: A starting point, not a fixed opacity — bright covers are still covered more heavily than dark ones from wherever this is set.

schema.label: Start Spotify at login, hidden
schema.description: Start playing a few seconds after login, with the window sent straight to a hidden workspace. The widget becomes the only interface: you never open the Spotify app. Off by default, because it starts a music player on its own.
